disabled.description: The fill a dead control wears.

on-disabled.description: The ink on a dead control's fill.

surface-sunken.description: Background of elements that sit below the page: table stripes, inset wells.

scrim.description: What dims the page behind a modal. A theme closes its dialogs over its own ink, not a neutral black.

field.description: A field's own surface. Distinct from `surface`, so a control reads as an inset object rather than a hole in the page, and distinct from `surface-raised`, so a card on a field is still two things.

border-strong.description: A control's own edge: stronger than `border`, which divides content. A field has to read as a field at a glance.

on-danger.description: The legacy name for the ink on the error fill. It points at `color.on-semantic-error` — the role the contract requires, the floor is measured on, and the danger button and the danger badge wear — so the two names can never disagree.

brand.description: The logotype face — one brand, every starter.

width.description: The hairline every control and surface draws with.

width-2.description: The emphasis edge: a control that must read as selected rather than merely bordered.

width-4.description: The heavy edge. Rare on purpose — a stroke this thick is a statement, not a divider.

width-8.description: The frame. A block drawn rather than outlined.

loop.description: The period of an endless animation: the skeleton's pulse and the loop utilities. A loop is watched rather than reacted to, so it is slower than any transition — and never faster than the floor below which it reads as a strobe.

sm.description: The size for a face in a list or a comment: it reads beside its label without leading the row.

md.description: The default: a face beside a name, or a profile header at rest.

lg.description: A face as the subject of a page: a profile header at the top of a long column.

max-width.description: The widest a tooltip grows; past this the label wraps.

edge.description: The stroke the badge draws around itself, so a small shape holds apart from the page. Zero leaves it a bare fill with no edge.

pill.description: Fully round reads as a pill; false squares it into a tag.

edge.description: The ink the button frames itself in. Both variants share it, so the pair reads as one size with one shadow.

shadow.description: The resting elevation. A control with no shadow sits on the page rather than in it.

shadow-hover.description: The hovered elevation. The lift is the hover feedback; without it a pointer tells the reader nothing.

radius.description: The corner rounding of a button.

depth.description: How physical a checkbox is: one scalar driving three inset shadows. Zero is flat and drawn; higher is lit and raised.
How physical a switch is: one scalar driving three inset shadows. Zero is flat and drawn; higher is lit and raised.

radius.description: The large step: a card is a big quiet thing, and a big quiet thing rounds a little more than a control does.

padding.description: The air inside the card, between its parts and around its edge.

border.description: The ink of the card's own edge: the page's hairline, because a rule is all that separates one thing from the next here.

elevation.description: The theme's resting step: a card sits on the page rather than floating above it.

width.description: The card's measure: the widest it is allowed to grow before it wraps.

width-narrow.description: A card in a narrow column.

width-wide.description: A card spanning a grid: the page's measure.

radius.description: The page's corner: a message is a box, and a box is not a pill.

padding.description: The air above and below the message.

padding-inline.description: The air beside the message, where it is read.

edge.description: The ink of the hairline on every side. The tone variants recolour the leading edge alone, so this one is the quiet frame around them.

border.description: The line a finger has to find: one step stronger than the dividers around it, or the control is not a control.

rule.description: The ink of the rule under a row: the page's hairline.

zebra.description: The fill a striped row wears: one step below the page, so a reader can hold their place across a wide table.

sm.description: Glyph sizes, from the reader's own root rather than the element they sit in — a step has to be a jump, and an `em` step against 14px prose is 2px.

md.description: Glyph sizes, from the reader's own root rather than the element they sit in — a step has to be a jump, and an `em` step against 14px prose is 2px.

lg.description: Glyph sizes, from the reader's own root rather than the element they sit in — a step has to be a jump, and an `em` step against 14px prose is 2px.

underline.description: A hair, one pixel at the body size: a link is found without being shouted at.

offset.description: The link's own decisions: the rule under it.

modes.description: The modes this theme serves. A mode the theme serves but does not override falls back to the base values.

$extends.description: The document this document layers over. Tokens the document states replace the base's; tokens it omits are inherited.
